how_we_chose: Parties appear if they have a sitting MP or average 2% or more in recent nationwide polls, and publish policies on their own website.
For each issue we show up to three policies per party, taken in the order the party lists them on its own website. Each policy appears once, under the issue it fits best.

Each policy is shown as a direct quote from the party's own page, in quotation marks, with a link so you can read the full policy. Quotes are cut at about 20 words; '…' marks a cut, and [square brackets] mark words we added for clarity.
A tag shows the type of source: a policy page, the 2026 manifesto, a dated announcement, a long-term policy, or a petition.
Where a party's policy pages don't cover an issue, we say so. This doesn't mean the party has no view on it.
Party order is shuffled each time the page loads, so no party is always first.
